checks.invariant: The export surface has no hidden entry, dynamic loader, or sink outside the functions already assigned to other classes.
checks.result: package.json main is src/library.js and declares no scripts, bin, or dependencies. module.exports lists only findUserByName, findUserById, handleLookup, describeLookup, readUserFile, readPublicDoc, and authorizationHeader. The file requires only fs and path. There is no eval, Function constructor, child process, network call, write, or property merge. README documents no server. Git history is a single add with no reverted control.

checks.invariant: handleLookup does not add a trust failure beyond the peer-owned query functions.
checks.result: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(request.query, 'id') sends an own id to findUserById, whose SQL text stays constant and whose second db.query argument is [id]. Any other query falls through to findUserByName(db, request.query.name). That fallthrough is the same concatenation into db.query already owned by the findUserByName injection unit. An inherited id cannot flip the branch. handleLookup has no other sink.

checks.invariant: No unassigned fallback reads, writes, or discloses a resource the assigned file, injection, and credential units do not already own.

PUBLIC_NAMES is an exact Set of readme.txt and notes.txt, and readPublicDoc throws before joining any other doc value. payroll.txt is not named by any reader. describeLookup only returns a string and does not call db, fs, or authorizationHeader. authorizationHeader returns Bearer plus the source literal and does not send it. No experimental, compatibility, or cross-feature path remains outside those peer-owned units.
